lines.en: My joints click across the floor.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出声，我不在乎。
lines.en: Every step makes noise. I don't care.

lines.zh: 我沿着走廊往你那边去。
lines.en: I go down the hall toward you.
One hundred health. Can you dent it?

lines.zh: 脸上的塑料在灯下发亮。
lines.en: The plastic of my face shines.
I lift my leg slowly.
Where I pass, grease remains.
I don't hide. I come straight.
My ear scraped the wall.
The threshold bent when I pushed through.
Stage to hallway. Not far.
I stand still in the middle of the hall.
The light flickered.
I tilt my head, then straighten it.
A faint motor hum.

lines.zh: 我在算还有多久到六点。
lines.en: I'm counting to six o'clock.
My fingers curl, joint by joint.
No breath. No heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我的吉他弦断了，可我不需要它。
lines.en: My guitar strings snapped; I do not need them.
There's light under the door.
You see me. Don't you.
Your flashlight is shaking.
This face was made for you.
Did you lock that door? I heard.

lines.zh: 我的吉他没带，手就够了。
lines.en: I left the guitar. My hands will do.

lines.zh: 我看你，就像看一段程序。
lines.en: I look at you like a line of code.

lines.zh: 我认得这栋楼的每块砖。
lines.en: I know every brick in this building.

lines.zh: 你别关灯，关了我更能看清。
lines.en: Don't kill the lights. I see better then.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在走廊里很长。
lines.en: Your breathing drags down the hall.

lines.zh: 你背后那扇门后面没人。
lines.en: No one's behind that door behind you.
The shell cracked. Steel shows.
I'm barely knocked back.

lines.zh: 这一下打到我的线束了。
lines.en: That hit my wiring.
My gait tilted slightly.
The joint grinds. Ugly sound.
I raise a hand to check the damage.
Minor damage. It won't matter.
The corner of my mouth didn't move.
The smell of pizza won't fool me.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西会掉下来。
lines.en: What you're holding will fall.
Put it down. You still have time.
There's sweat on your hands.

lines.zh: 我闻得到你手里的铁味。
lines.en: I smell the iron in your grip.
Your hands shake. Can't hold it?
Lift it higher. I can see clearly.
You thought I'd be distracted?
I want parts, not bread.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是硬塑料和钢架。
lines.en: You hit plastic and steel framing.
I barely move.
You bounced off. I heard.
Don't press. The joints pinch.
Pushing me is like pushing a wall.

lines.zh: 你的护甲撞在我的胸口。
lines.en: Your armor knocked on my chest.

lines.zh: 我们卡在这条走廊里了。
lines.en: We're stuck in this corridor.
Cable underfoot. Careful.
I lower my head; you step back.
I've recorded this motion.

lines.zh: 两只玩偶站在一起，很挤。
lines.en: Two animatronics standing together is cramped.
We don't have that.
Don't watch. This part's ugly.

lines.zh: 关节转不了那么多角度。
lines.en: The joints don't turn that far.
It's older than I am.
We push together with a click.
Afterwards, nothing has changed.
Someone's watching from behind the screen.
This shouldn't be in the footage.
I pick up a part.
My fingers are too thick to grip.

lines.zh: 这个螺丝我曾经也有一枚。
lines.en: I used to have a screw like this.

lines.zh: 我把它攥在手里，咔咔响。
lines.en: I crush it in my hand, clicking.

lines.zh: 地上的东西都归管理处。
lines.en: Anything on the floor belongs to management.

lines.zh: 我把玩偶的头捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up a doll's head.
This hand holds only one thing.
Shoved into my chest, the gears jam.

lines.zh: 零件在我体内转了一圈。
lines.en: The part turned once inside me.
I'd like that flashlight.

lines.zh: 找到你了，就在走廊尽头。
lines.en: Found you, at the end of the hall.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我听见声了。
lines.en: You dropped something. I heard it.
Your flashlight gave you away.
The door's open, so you've nowhere to hide.
Forty a hit. Enough?

lines.zh: 我不是撞出来的，是被放出来的。
lines.en: I didn't spawn. I was let out.
Every camera here answers to me.
I don't run. I walk. Fast enough.
Your breathing is behind the door.
I've watched this shift a long time.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作很慢，看得清。
lines.en: My arm rises slowly. You can see it.
They're all coming this way.
You lost to the breaker, not to me.

lines.zh: 走廊只有两头，一头是我。
lines.en: This hall has two ends. I'm one.
I pushed the door open.
Don't shout now. Nobody's on duty.
I check room by room.
You're in the supply closet. I heard.

lines.zh: 摄像头的位置我都知道。
lines.en: I know every camera's blind spot.
There's only you behind that door.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在走廊回响。
lines.en: My footsteps echo down the hall.
The hall lights flickered again.
You've retreated to the office.

lines.zh: 你把门堵上了，我推得开。
lines.en: You blocked the door. I can push it.
My steps stopped outside the door.

lines.zh: 你关掉一半的灯，没用的。
lines.en: Killing half the lights won't help.
My blue shell glows in the dark.
You moved to another hall.
The vent is too small. I won't go in.
I walk slowly along the wall.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声比我快，会累的。
lines.en: Your steps are faster. You'll tire.
I've blocked the end of the hall.
You're drawing less power now.
I've stood outside this door three minutes.
There's no second exit in there.
Open it and we're face to face.
My hand comes down hard.
There's steel under this plush hand.
Forty a hit. You won't recover.
A joint clicked.
You blocked it. Your arm clicked.
I don't pause. I keep pushing.
You're at the door. It's shut.

lines.zh: 这一下留着给下一个人。
lines.en: That one's saved for the next visitor.
You fell onto the cables.
My face is right in front of yours.
Shouting won't help. Thick walls.
One more and it's enough.

lines.zh: 第二只手从侧面扫过来。
lines.en: My second hand sweeps in from the side.

lines.zh: 金属拳套在你胸口留印。
lines.en: My metal knuckles leave a mark on your chest.
I'm laughing. Can you hear it?
You pushed me off. Almost.
Let's drag this out until six.

lines.zh: 舞台的幕布后面站起来了。
lines.en: Behind the stage curtain, something stood.
I come out of the supply room.
The lights came on. I'm here.

lines.zh: 我没刷出来，我是被搬来的。
lines.en: I didn't spawn. I was moved here.
The floor creaks under my weight.

lines.zh: 我在这栋楼里等了很久。
lines.en: I've waited long in this building.
At midnight, I started.
My ear comes out first.
The breaker clicked. I woke up.
A shape at the end of the hall.
I walk slowly into the light.
You could still run now.

lines.zh: 电路烧起来，我的动作乱了。
lines.en: Circuits burned and my movements scrambled.

lines.zh: 钢架落地，整个身体震了一下。
lines.en: The frame hit the floor; the whole body shook.

lines.zh: 水进了电机，声音变得很怪。
lines.en: Water reached the motor. It sounds wrong.
The blast tore my shell open.

lines.zh: 箭扎进塑料壳，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow stuck in the plastic shell.

lines.zh: 这光让我短暂停了半秒。
lines.en: That light stopped me for half a second.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，电量在降而已。
lines.en: I don't eat. My power is just draining.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的线路全乱了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my circuits scrambled.

lines.zh: 掉下去时我还在唱那首歌。
lines.en: Falling, I was still singing that song.
